manifest_name: Guided Swing DEBUG Audition Source Manifest
scope: DEBUG-only Guided Swing audition assets. These files do not replace the live Guided Swing profile.

assets.attribution_text: IDRIJA, ANTHONY`S SHAFT; A WINCH FOR LOWERING WOOD by Sounds of Changes, licensed under CC BY 3.0.
assets.notes: Selected as the first Cable Winch backswing candidate because it is real winch material with steady mechanical pull energy and lower toy/carnival character than the Premium Lift Hill baseline.
assets.editing_trimming_conversion: Downloaded the Wikimedia Commons media source, converted to WAV, extracted a 1.70 second excerpt from 28.60s to 30.30s, downmixed stereo to mono, applied 22ms fade in and 55ms fade out, and peak-normalized to 0.78 for DEBUG audition playback.

assets.attribution_text: IDRIJA, ANTHONY`S SHAFT; A WINCH FOR LOWERING WOOD by Sounds of Changes, licensed under CC BY 3.0.
assets.notes: Selected as the first Cable Winch impact candidate because it is a short dry mechanical accent from the same real winch source and should serve as a compact non-cartoon confirmation cue.
assets.editing_trimming_conversion: Downloaded the Wikimedia Commons media source, converted to WAV, extracted a 0.28 second excerpt from 16.80s to 17.08s, downmixed stereo to mono, applied 2ms fade in and 45ms fade out, and peak-normalized to 0.68 for DEBUG audition playback.

sources_rejected.reason_rejected: Legally usable, but its strongest transient windows measured brighter and noisier than the selected source, making it a weaker first fit for the dry restrained Cable Winch target.
